nodes.name: Optimization Problem for FixMatch
assumptions: $f_{\btheta}$ is a standard neural network with softmax output layer, $\btheta \in \Re^n$, $\ell$ is the number of training examples, $K$ is the number of the classes, and $n$ is the total number of the parameters of $f_{\btheta}$. $C > 0$ is the parameter to avoid overfitting by regularization, $\bx^i$ is the $i$th input image, and $\by^i$ is the label vector of $\bx^i$.
conclusions: Optimize the function $f(\btheta)$ subject to the given conditions.
nodes.label: fixmatch-obj

nodes.name: Loss Function for FixMatch
assumptions: $\hat{\by}^i$ is the pseudo label vector of $\bx^i, i \in S_u$, $\lambda_u$ is a pre-defined parameter, $\bx^i_w$ is the weakly augmented image of $\bx^i$, $\bx^i_s$ is the strongly augmented image of $\bx^i$, $\xi_l$ is a loss function for the labeled data, and $\xi_u$ is a loss function for the unlabeled data.
conclusions: Define the loss function $\xi$ for both labeled and unlabeled data.
nodes.label: fixmatch-loss

nodes.name: Confidence Filtering for Unlabeled Data in FixMatch
assumptions: $\mathbb{1}$ is an indicator function, $\text{OHL}$ is a function mapping a softmax pseudo label vector to its one-hot label vector, and $\tau > 0$ is a pre-defined threshold for pseudo label confidence.
conclusions: Filter pseudo labels to retain only those with confidence above a threshold.
nodes.label: fixmatch-filter
